Enable multi-language detection and inspect every ISO 639-3 code that clears the confidence threshold.

```swift title="Swift"
import Xberg

let result = try await Xberg.extract("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"text/markdown\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/markdown/comprehensive.md\"}", "{\"language_detection\":{\"detect_multiple\":true,\"enabled\":true,\"min_confidence\":0.3}}")
debugPrint(result.results()[0].detectedLanguages() as Any)
```
